ablation.name: semantic_sinkhorn_ot
ablation.notes: Round10: Semantic Sinkhorn OT (user spec 方案一). Log-domain stabilized Sinkhorn with uniform marginals. Solves Patch-Match many-to-one collapse. eps=0.05, iters=20, alpha=0.5. Sweet spot: sharper than Local AdaIN (softmax over all N), softer than Patch-Match (hard argmax). When eps->0, Pi approaches permutation matrix.
